statement.zh: **事件**：HQC 与 BIKE 备选（HQC and BIKE as Backup KEMs）。2024 年前后，NIST 后量子标准化进程继续评估备选 KEM，BIKE 与 HQC 成为code-based 方案的主要候选。两者都把安全性建立在纠错码解码困难性上，区别在码族、参数和实现取舍。
statement.en: **Event**: HQC and BIKE as Backup KEMs.It is registered under post-quantum cryptography, dated 2024.

statement.zh: HQC 与 BIKE 备选的why见来源账本与正文其他节；该条目不以空段充数。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in post-quantum cryptography, not because of its name.
